description: Cancel one delivery that is still queued. Refused with 409 once it is being sent or has been sent. Each account of a post is its own delivery, so cancel each one that should not go out.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.

name: jobs_cancel
title: Cancel a scheduled post
